# CleanerClicks

> CleanerClicks builds high-converting websites and lead-capture & follow-up automation systems for service businesses (cleaning, pressure washing, landscaping, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, and similar trades). The system turns every missed call into a booked job through instant text-back, 1-year automated follow-up, and a 5-star review engine. Based in Fargo, ND. Also written as "Cleaner Clicks."

## Founder
Adam Selman

## What CleanerClicks does
- Custom, conversion-tuned websites for service businesses (designed, built, and hosted)
- Missed Call Text Back — auto-texts every missed call in under a minute
- 1-Year Follow-Up — 52 automated touchpoints across SMS, email, and voicemail
- 5-Star Review Engine — one-tap Google reviews after every job
- Smart Lead Capture — forms, click-to-call, source tracking, unified inbox

## Who it's for
Local home-service businesses (typically 1–10 person shops): roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, pressure washing, landscaping, pest control, garage door, and locksmith.

## Pricing
- Essentials — $197/mo: website, hosting, domain, logo, automated review responses, quote forms, missed-call text back
- Professional — $297/mo: adds 1-year lead follow-up, 4–5★ review filter, live chat, customer confirmations, unified inbox, full support
- Elite — $497/mo: adds a full SEO program
Month-to-month, no setup fees, no per-seat upcharges. Setup is ~14 days.
